name: Beijing Central Axis: A Building Ensemble Exhibiting the Ideal Order of the Chinese Capital
description: The Central Axis is a 7.8-kilometre line running through the heart of Beijing, from the Drum and Bell Towers in the north to Yongdingmen Gate in the south. Along it you pass the Forbidden City's palaces, imperial gardens and ceremonial gates. The layout began under the Yuan dynasty in the 13th century, and Ming and Qing rulers later built on it, following an ancient text's blueprint for an ideal capital.
